questions.key_step: Differentiate the determinant row by row and evaluate at $x=0$.
questions.justification: Differentiation of a determinant - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Continuity gives $b=0$; logarithmic differentiation gives $f'(1)$ and hence the slope.
questions.justification: Continuity and differentiability of a piecewise function; Logarithmic differentiation - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Rewrite with $x-\pi/4$, simplify to $-1/(1+\cos u)$, differentiate twice.
questions.justification: Differentiation of trigonometric functions - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Expand each $(\cos kx)^{1/k}$ to $1-kx^2/2$ and sum $1+2+\dots+10$.
questions.justification: Limits using series expansion of cosine - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Treat $f'(1),f''(2),f'''(3)$ as constants and solve the linear system.
questions.justification: Higher-order derivatives of a polynomial - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Factor $x^2-\sqrt x$ as a difference of cubes so the fraction collapses to $x-1$.
questions.justification: Simplification before differentiation; Differentiation of trigonometric functions - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Mirror symmetry in $y=x$ and parallel tangents at the closest points.
questions.justification: Tangent and normal: geometry of two parabolas - level 3 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Differentiate $V=\frac43\pi(r+\alpha)^3$ with $r$ fixed to find $r$.
questions.justification: Rate of change (related rates) - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Centre on the axis, tangent to the lines at $30^\circ$ gives $r=k/2$; vertex contact gives $r=2$.
questions.justification: Tangent and normal: circle touching a parabola and lines - level 3 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Normal parallel to the line means $y'=90$; count the real roots of the quartic.
questions.justification: Tangent and normal: normals parallel to a given line - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Recognise the expression as squared distance from $(7,4)$ to the upper semicircle.
questions.justification: Maximum and minimum of a distance expression (geometric interpretation) - level 3 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Largest circle radius equals the least distance from $(2,0)$ to the ellipse.
questions.justification: Largest circle inscribed in an ellipse (minimum distance from a point) - level 3 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: $1^\infty$ limit gives $\alpha=3f'(2)$; then cubic has a double root, so two intersections.
questions.justification: Limits of the form 1 to the power infinity; Number of real roots of a cubic - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: $f'=(x^2-9)/(3x^2)$ changes sign at $\pm3$; the point $0$ is excluded.
questions.justification: Monotonicity from the sign of the derivative - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Largest increasing interval ends where $f'=0$, so $f'(3)=0$ gives $a=4$; then sign of $g'$.
questions.justification: Monotonicity and intervals of increase/decrease - level 3 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Bound $f'>0$ using $\cos x\ge0$ and the linear part; $f''<0$ for $f'$ decreasing.
questions.justification: Monotonicity: statements on f and f' - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Critical points include $x=2$ where $f'$ does not exist.
questions.justification: Critical points - level 1 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: $f'=-(1+\sin x)\le0$ so strictly decreasing; sign change gives one root.
questions.justification: Monotonicity and number of roots - level 2 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: Recognise $4c^3-3c=\cos3\theta$ and use monotonicity for uniqueness.
questions.justification: Number of roots of a cubic; Triple-angle formula for cosine - level 3 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).

questions.key_step: $f'=-(x^2+16)/D^2<0$ on the domain.
questions.justification: Monotonicity of a rational function - level 1 set from the key step above (paper is JEE Main standard, so well below the Advanced anchors).
